skill.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
skill.description: Converts Markdown files to styled HTML for WeChat-style publishing, with themes, code highlighting, math, diagrams, alerts, footnotes, and image handling.
skill.summary: Convert Markdown into styled, WeChat-compatible HTML documents.
skill.author: jimliu

security_audit.summary: Confirmed risks include external npx/Bun execution, broad local file reads and writes, remote resource fetching, remote dynamic imports, and unsafe HTML insertion surfaces. Most backtick, regex exec, SVG coordinate, CSS border, and JSFuck heuristic hits are false positives from normal TypeScript and markup. No evidence of prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md or the scanned scripts.

remediation.issue: External command execution through npx and Bun
remediation.suggestion: Replace the subprocess call with a direct renderer API or pin and vendor the runtime dependencies used by the skill.
Escape all attribute values and text nodes, and sanitize generated HTML before writing or embedding it.
Require user confirmation or an allowlist before downloading remote images or rendering PlantUML through external services.

remediation.issue: Remote dynamic imports for syntax grammars
remediation.suggestion: Validate language names against a fixed allowlist and prefer locally bundled highlight.js grammars.

remediation.issue: Temporary files and broad path access
remediation.suggestion: Constrain input and output paths, remove temporary directories after conversion, and avoid defaulting to developer-local theme paths.

content.value_statement: Publishing Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML can require careful formatting and inline styles. This skill converts Markdown files into themed HTML with diagrams, math, alerts, and code highlighting.
actual_capabilities: Converts a local Markdown file into an HTML file in the same directory.
Applies the default, grace, or simple theme during rendering.
Reads frontmatter for title, author, description, and summary metadata.
Renders code highlighting, math, PlantUML, Mermaid, alerts, footnotes, ruby text, sliders, and infographics.
Backs up an existing HTML output before writing a replacement.
Resolves local and remote Markdown image references and reports image mappings.
limitations: The converter runs local TypeScript through npx and Bun.
Output is written next to the input Markdown file.
Remote images and PlantUML diagrams may make network requests.
Generated HTML is not safe for untrusted Markdown without extra sanitization.

output_examples.output: An HTML article is created beside the Markdown file, with themed styling and a list of image mappings.

output_examples.output: The guide is rendered as styled HTML with diagram placeholders, formatted equations, highlighted code, and footnote sections.

output_examples.output: The previous HTML file is backed up with a timestamp, then the new themed HTML file is written.

best_practices: Review Markdown from untrusted sources before conversion.
Use local images when network access is not required.
Choose the theme before conversion to avoid repeated output changes.
anti_patterns: Do not convert secret or private Markdown on shared machines without reviewing temporary files.
Do not paste generated HTML from untrusted Markdown into privileged web pages.
Do not rely on remote diagrams or images for offline publishing.
